question: Approve this design to enter implementation? Collapses the measured 10-command gate ceremony to 2 (gate record --consume, dispatch build --stamp) via implicit state sync scoped to gate record/consume only (prepare excluded after staff review).

artifacts.summary: Two flags on existing verbs (gate record --consume; dispatch build --stamp) plus implicit state sync inside gate record/consume replace the measured 10 binary/git commands with 2, without moving any authority boundary. An independent staff review found real gaps (network I/O added to gate prepare with zero AC-1 benefit; two contract clauses that would misroute a new sync-failure exit; an underspecified --consume exit space; an unexercised rebase-conflict path; one tautological AC-1 assertion) -- all five fixed and spot-checked: mechanism 1 narrowed to record/consume only, the shared-core and dispatch-core doc gaps closed, an 8-row sync=/phase= discriminator added, a real two-writer conflict-HALT spike run (exit 3 demonstrated, not asserted), and AC-1's verification reframed around real end-state parity.
